sourceCandidatePolicy: Finite existing exact source pins retained for review; acquiring them is a separate release and does not prove a fulfilled source offer.

transport.credentialSources: No environment/user Docker config, saved auth, proxy credentials, host home or model credentials.
transport.registryRedirect: Refuse redirect; any registry CDN URL/token flow needs exact independent metadata review first. Anonymous registry token may exist only in memory and must never enter logs/receipt.
